findings.defect: The draft replaces the respectful martial address “Young Hero Chul” with “Senior Chulwoo,” incorrectly implying that the speaker recognizes Chulwoo as a hierarchical senior.
findings.rationale: 소협 is the established address “Young Hero,” not “Senior”; preserving it matters because this exchange revolves around unrecognized sect hierarchy.

findings.current:
“No. You don’t.”

Wipeng looked me up and down as though he were looking at an insect.
findings.defect: Taekyung’s emphatic protest is omitted, weakening the comic beat and his aggrieved reaction before Wipeng’s contemptuous look.
findings.rationale: 왜! 어째서! is explicit dialogue and must be retained.
findings.replacement:
“No. You don’t.”

“Why?! How come?!”

Wipeng looked me up and down as though he were looking at an insect.
findings.source:
“예. 없습니다.”

“왜! 어째서!”

위팽이 벌레를 보는 듯한 눈빛으로 나를 훑었다.

findings.current:
It would have been unfair if I had actually gone to pleasure houses.

Hell, I couldn’t even go to a pickup bar.
findings.defect: The first sentence reverses the source: Taekyung says he would not feel wronged if he had actually visited a pleasure house, not that visiting one would make the accusation unfair. The second sentence also turns a lack of past experience into a vague inability and softens the profanity.
findings.rationale: 가 봤으면 억울하지나 않지 negates his grievance under the hypothetical, while 못 가 봤는데 means he has never even experienced going to the less explicit venue.
findings.replacement:
If I’d actually been to one, at least I wouldn’t feel so wronged.

Fuck, I’d never even been to a pickup bar, let alone a pleasure house.
findings.source:
차라리 가 봤으면 억울하지나 않지.

기루는 시발, 헌팅 술집도 못 가 봤는데.

findings.current:
“Finish walking the path of a martial artist. Don’t wander off onto some pointless side road.”

That was when a voice cut in.
findings.defect: The narration omits that Taekyung delivers the line with overt disdain for Chulwoo, removing the reaction that completes the joke.
findings.rationale: 한심한 감정을 가득 담아 explicitly describes the contemptuous emotion Taekyung puts into his reply.
findings.replacement:
“Finish walking the path of a martial artist. Don’t go wandering down side paths for no reason.”

I replied with utter disdain. That was when a voice cut in.
findings.source:
“……무인의 길이나 마저 걸어라. 괜히 샛길로 빠지지 말고.”

한심한 감정을 가득 담아 대답한 그때였다.

findings.current:
The Sword Saint had been living in seclusion for several decades already.

And now his Disciple, whose life or death was barely known, had suddenly appeared in Murim?
findings.defect: The draft attaches the unknown life-or-death status to the Disciple. The source says no one knows whether the long-secluded Sword Saint is alive or dead, making his Disciple’s sudden appearance startling.
findings.rationale: The contextual subject of 살았는지, 죽었는지도 잘 알려지지 않은 is the Sword Saint, whose decades-long seclusion is stated immediately beforehand.
findings.replacement:
The Sword Saint had already been living in seclusion for decades.

No one even knew whether he was alive or dead, and now his Disciple had suddenly appeared in Murim?
findings.source:
검성이 은거한 지 이미 수십 년이다.

살았는지, 죽었는지도 잘 알려지지 않은 그의 제자가 갑자기 무림에 나오다니?

findings.current: “If this really is the Sword Saint’s Disciple…”
findings.defect: The draft changes an unfinished guess about the destination of the Elder’s order into a conditional statement questioning the Disciple’s identity.
findings.rationale: 혹시 here tentatively asks whether the Elder means to go to the Sword Saint’s Disciple, continuing the preceding question “Where?”
findings.replacement: “Could you mean the Sword Saint’s Disciple…?”

summary: Two critical subject/negation errors, two meaningful omissions, one hierarchy error, and one altered incomplete question.
